subject: Action grid: MAP draft & proposed timeline (post-discovery)
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@helixhealth.com>, Will Carter <will.carter@helixhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Action grid: MAP draft & proposed timeline (post-discovery)

Thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today — appreciated the clarity on performance targets and regulatory constraints. I captured a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (attached) and a proposed action grid below so we have alignment before we build the formal MAP. Please review and confirm stakeholders and owners.

Key takeaways from the call:
- Decision criteria: response latency < 200ms p50 on typical clinical prompts; per-token cost target to remain within procurement thresholds.
- Primary dependencies: security questionnaire completion, data residency confirmation, procurement SOW approval.
- Success metrics: pilot (10k monthly active tokens) within 6 weeks, production readiness in subsequent window.

Proposed milestones (two options):
1) Option A — Accelerated (6 weeks):
  - Week 1: MAP sign-off & security Q answers
  - Week 2–3: PoC environment + model selection
  - Week 4: Integration and perf tuning
  - Week 5: Pilot validation
  - Week 6: Pilot close + contract sign
2) Option B — Conservative (10 weeks): adds additional buffer for procurement and audit scheduling.

Initial responsibilities (suggested):
- Helix Health: Will Carter (CTO) — integration owner; Procurement (procurement@helixhealth.com) — commercial lead; security contact (please confirm).
- Redwood: Rishi Malhotra — commercial lead; Laura Bennett — solution delivery; Sergio Alvarez — technical onboarding & performance.

Asks:
- Can you confirm the security contact we should loop in for the SOC2 questionnaire?
- Which timeline option do you prefer, and do you have target close windows (e.g., end of Q1)?

Attached: redwood_map_draft_v1.xlsx (initial MAP + milestone checklist)

Thanks — I’ll hold action items open until I hear confirmation and will incorporate edits into a v2.

—
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@helixhealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Will Carter <will.carter@helixhealth.com>, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com, procurement@helixhealth.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Action grid: MAP draft & proposed timeline (post-discovery)

Rishi — thanks for the clear recap and the draft. This is very helpful. A few quick confirmations from our side: 

Stakeholders to include (please add to MAP):
- Will Carter — CTO (integration owner)
- Priya Shah — Head of Security (priya.shah@helixhealth.com)
- Mark Reynolds — Procurement (procurement@helixhealth.com)
- Clinical Ops: Dr. Anika Bose (anika.bose@helixhealth.com) — validation lead

Dependencies to add:
- Data residency confirmation (we need EU-only storage for subset of PHI-related logs)
- Vendor security questionnaire completion — I attached our standard questionnaire for vendors; can you confirm a target date to return answers?

Timeline preference: Option B (conservative) looks safer given our audit calendar, but we’d like to aim for a compressed Option B if you can commit to dedicated delivery support. Target close: ideally before the end of Q1 but procurement may stretch into early Q2.

I’ve attached the vendor-security-questionnaire.pdf for your team. Can Laura or Sergio confirm feasibility of the compressed conservative timeline and identify any immediate blockers?

Best,
Emma
Emma Jones
Director of Digital Programs | Helix Health
emma.jones@helixhealth.com
From: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
To: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Action grid: MAP draft & proposed timeline (post-discovery)

Quick internal note — I reviewed the questionnaire Emma attached. High level: we can return answers in ~5 business days if we allocate an engineer and security SME to the task this week. Sergio, can you estimate effort to validate EU-only storage option (config + SOC evidence) and whether we should propose Redwood Private as a fallback? If so, we should call that out in the MAP dependencies.

Also recommend we propose a canary rollout (50 users) as a gating milestone before pilot expansion — reduces risk for Helix and buys procurement confidence.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@helixhealth.com>, Will Carter <will.carter@helixhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com, procurement@helixhealth.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 18:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Action grid: MAP draft & proposed timeline (post-discovery)

Thanks Emma — really useful. Per internal check: Laura and Sergio confirmed we can complete the security questionnaire in ~5 business days if Helix agrees to a short Q&A call. Sergio will send a separate note with EU residency validation ETA.

Updated asks / next steps (I will update the MAP and circulate v2 by EOD Monday):
- R: Confirm Priya Shah (security) and Mark Reynolds (procurement) are the correct points — Helix to introduce on email.
- R: Schedule a 30-minute security Q&A (suggest Tue/Wed next week) — suggested attendees: Priya Shah, Sergio Alvarez, Laura Bennett.
- Helix: Confirm preferred timeline (we heard conservative with compression) and procurement windows; I’ll reflect this in the MAP milestones.
- Both: Agree on canary gating criteria (suggest: 50 users, pass latency and basic QA checklist).

Attached: redwood_map_draft_v2.xlsx (includes canary milestone & updated responsibility grid).

References:
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/HLX-019
- Draft MAP folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_map_folder
- DocuSign template (commercial): https://www.docusign.com/en/containers/abc123

I’ll follow up with a short calendar invite for the security Q&A once I get introductions.

—
Rishi
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
